sentences.en: To save herself, Layla jumped out the second storey window.
sentences.zh: 为了自救，莱拉跳出了二楼的窗户。

sentences.en: All storeys of the house are made of wood.
sentences.zh: 这所房子的所有楼层都是用木头建造的。

sentences.en: Fadil killed himself by jumping off an 8-storey building.
sentences.zh: 法迪尔从一栋八层楼高的建筑上跳下自杀。
